title: Backup Policy Compiler
description: Compiles the database backup policy. Enforces: PITR window defined and meeting RPO, backup retention exceeding PITR window, geo-redundancy for production, WAL archiving configured, and backup retention compliance with declared jurisdiction minimums.

error_codes.DBP001: backup-policy.json missing or invalid — required fields: environments[], pitr_window_hours, rpo_hours, retention_days, backup_destination
error_codes.DBP002: PITR window not defined — point-in-time recovery window must be declared per environment
error_codes.DBP003: PITR window is shorter than declared RPO — recovery window must cover the full RPO requirement
error_codes.DBP004: Backup retention period is shorter than PITR window or below compliance minimum for declared jurisdiction
error_codes.DBP005: Production instance missing geo-redundant backup — cross-region backup replication is required for production
error_codes.DBP006: WAL archiving not configured — continuous WAL archiving is required to enable point-in-time recovery
